newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Manager sets Czech state bond auction for Monday.
newsitem.headline: Manager sets Czech state bond auction for Monday.

text.p: OFT Brokers, manager of the Finance Ministry's state bond auction, said on Thursday it would hold an auction next Monday of 2.85 billion crowns worth of five-year state bonds held over from an auction in 1996.
The bonds bear a 10.95 fixed coupon, and their minimum price will be announced on Friday, OFT said in a statement.
The bonds were issued last August but only 1.9 billion worth were actually sold.

In last week's auction, bonds worth about 300 million were sold due to a mix-up that left bidders without key information on the issue's minimum price, leaving 2.85 billion of the issue for Monday's auction.
OFT said the minimum amount sold would be five million crowns. Price will be the top criterion for evaluating bids, followed by amount.
Auctions will continue every Monday until the whole amount is sold, the statement said.
The Czech National Bank on Thursday set a separate auction of five billion crowns in five-year state bonds for February 2, a completely separate issue which analysts expect to be fully subscribed.
